content:
Retrieves details for the specified exposure view card. By default, the response includes SLA
efficiency and trend data for the past 30 days. You can modify the time frame using optional
parameters.
Caution: This endpoint is available for use but is currently in beta. The response structure is subject
to change as we continue to enhance the data model.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the TONE_UI.TONE_EXPOSURE_CARD.READ ,
LUMIN_EXPOSURE_VIEW.EXPOSURE_CARD.READ  and AD.TOGGLE_AD.USE  custom role privileges.
See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
The unique ID of the card to retrieve details for.
QUERY PARAMETERS
string <date-time>
The start date for trend data. Use this parameter in combination
with the trend_end_date  parameter to define the time frame
for the trend data.
The date must be specified as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601
format (e.g., 2025-06-28T00:00:00.000Z ).
string <date-time>
The end date for trend data. Use this parameter in combination
with the trend_start_date  parameter to define the time
frame for the trend data.
card_id
required
trend_start_date
trend_end_date
The date must be specified as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601
format (e.g., 2025-06-28T00:00:00.000Z ).
string <date-time>
The start date for SLA efficiency data. Use this parameter in
combination with the sla_efficiency_end_date  parameter
to define the time frame for the SLA efficiency.
The date must be specified as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601
format (e.g., 2025-06-28T00:00:00.000Z ).
string <date-time>
The end date for SLA efficiency data. Use this parameter in
combination with the sla_efficiency_start_date
parameter to define the time frame for the SLA efficiency.
The date must be specified as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601
format (e.g., 2025-06-28T00:00:00.000Z ).
string
Default: "ANY"
Enum: "ANY"
"REMEDIATED"
"NON_REMEDIATED"
Filter SLA breakdown data by REMEDIATED ,
NON_REMEDIATED , or ANY .
boolean
Default: false
Indicates whether or not to include trend events.
